name: Umisora no Fragments
source:
When he was small, Shin made a promise with a girl who only visited the island for the summer. They promised to attend the same school when they grew up, so that they could always be together. This childhood memory and innocent promise faded as the months and years passed by. However, everything changed when he saw a photo of a student council president in one of the school brochures which he was leafing through. He decided to enrol in that school, the promised school.

Shin attended the entrance ceremony with expectations of a new school life, but it was suddenly announced that the school would be closing in a few months. He was obviously disappointed by the news, but he was determined to bring the "rose-coloured school life" which he had dreamt of into reality. The first step was joining the student council which was full of beauties. It would be the quickest way to attain his dream.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/04/01/april-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
当他还小的时候，申和一个只在夏天去过岛上的女孩许下承诺。他们约定长大后要上同一所学校，这样就可以永远在一起。随着岁月的流逝，童年的记忆和纯真的承诺逐渐消失。然而，当他在翻阅的一本学校宣传册上看到学生会主席的照片时，一切都发生了变化。他决定就读那所学校，约定的学校。

申怀着对新学校生活的期待参加了入学典礼，却突然宣布几个月后学校将关闭。他显然对这个消息感到失望，但他决心将自己梦想的“玫瑰色的学校生活”变成现实。第一步就是加入美女云集的学生会。这将是实现他的梦想的最快方法。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/04/01/april-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
